name: nagless
description: Popup & nag blocker — hides uninvited overlays, unlocks scrolling, dismisses the keyboard.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:android: npm run build && web-ext run -t firefox-android --source-dir dist/firefox --firefox-apk org.mozilla.firefox
scripts.sign: npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel listed
